subject.title: fix: show native history in adopted Pi and OpenCode sessions

question: Should `importSessionCatalogHistory` be a supported public plugin SDK API for external catalog plugins, with its persisted transcript and deduplication semantics treated as a durable contract?
rationale: The helper is exported from the public plugin SDK and writes session transcript state; implementation evidence cannot determine the intended external API boundary.

options.title: Accept the public contract
options.body: Keep the export and explicitly document and test the behavioral guarantees that third-party catalog plugins may rely on.

options.title: Keep transcript import internal
options.body: Remove the public export and use an internal core runtime seam for the bundled Pi and OpenCode plugins until a narrower external contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the export and explicitly document and test the behavioral guarantees that third-party catalog plugins may rely on.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged and current-branch history directly connects this contributor to the adopted Pi/OpenCode catalog workflow and importer design.
